extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the pursuer in a Court of Session financial provision action asks whether funding of £23,000 is available, with matrimonial property of around £230,000, and whether lending is offered in Scotland.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the clear summary of the matter. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the proceedings are raised, as our funding is arranged for matters in England and Wales. It would also help to have details of the matrimonial property and how it is held, any dates fixed for proof or other hearings, and an estimate of costs through to conclusion. Once we have that information a colleague will review the enquiry and come back to you. Please do not treat this acknowledgement as any indication of whether funding can be offered.
